video_title: AI or CP3: Channing PICKS a Winner, Top 5 SNUBS Luka & Kobe's Aura Lives On

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye compares Steve Nash and Russell Westbrook as players
quotes.excerpt: Steve Nash is a better player than Russell Westbrook. Russell Westbrook is the most top two most athletic
quotes.quote: Steve Nash is a better player than Russell Westbrook. Russell Westbrook is the most top two most athletic guard ever to play basketball. But Steve Nash is a 50-40-90 guy, where Russell has just God-given ability and motor that no one has ever seen before. Steve Nash is my guy, so yes, Steve Nash is better than Russell Westbrook.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye doubts the Dallas Mavericks' current roster construction
quotes.excerpt: I don't like the way that team is built at all. They're going to lose to a team
quotes.quote: I don't like the way that team is built at all. And maybe something happens, but no, they're going to lose to a team like Denver, Minnesota, Oklahoma City, Houston, Phoenix, Utah. I just don't see the way that this team is built that they're really going to compete versus those type of other teams.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye critiques the Dallas Mavericks' current roster compared to the past
quotes.excerpt: He needs to be surrounded by defensive athletes, guys that can get out and play, make their own
quotes.quote: He needs to be surrounded by defensive athletes, guys that can get out and play, make their own plays. This team feels very floppy and very half-court sets team. This doesn't seem like a team that's going to get out and just run. But maybe that's not what Luka wants to do anymore. I felt like the other team definitely wanted to get out, run, be athletic, and then when things got down in the half-court, they would just go to Luka, where this team seems like they want to live in the half-court.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye discusses the feasibility of more NBA games in the UK
quotes.excerpt: a six-hour time zone is going to take a Western Conference team two weeks to get over
quotes.quote: Going to the UK is huge. I went, I love it. But yeah, I think they need to have a couple more games, especially how good the Eastern Conference is over in the UK. A six-hour time zone is going to take a Western Conference team two weeks to get over that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye ranks Allen Iverson among the most influential players ever
quotes.excerpt: I think Allen Iverson is the one of the top three most influential players ever to play basketball
quotes.quote: I think Allen Iverson is the one of the top three most influential players ever to play basketball. But if we're looking at careers, Chris Paul's career is better than Allen Iverson's.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye lists his top five NBA players at this moment
quotes.excerpt: SGA, Luka, Wemby, Jalen Brunson, Anthony Edwards
quotes.quote: SGA, Luka, Wemby, Jalen Brunson, Anthony Edwards.

quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye ranks the greatest guards in NBA history

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye explains why he would choose the Phoenix Suns for his career
quotes.excerpt: There has not been a team more consistent, not only in coaching, vision, the type of players
quotes.quote: There has not been a team more consistent, not only in coaching, vision, the type of players that they have, the standard that they set every single year that they go out and play. From 2005 to 2019, I'd have what, three championships and be able to compete and play with some elite players.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye discusses the most difficult players to guard in his career
quotes.excerpt: Probably Dirk, because he's so damn nice
quotes.quote: Probably Dirk, because he's so damn nice and I grew up, not grew up, but I watched a lot of Dirk. I loved his game and he was just unguardable. It was literally like, what am I going to do? And he's an inch taller than me and shoots the way he does. He was smart, he's a big dude, strong. I mean, it was just like, God, I'm so tired of having to guard this guy. And then he'd be the nicest guy and you're like, shut up, Dirk. I hate that you're nice and I like you.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye reflects on the 2016 Cleveland Cavaliers championship team
quotes.excerpt: I really feel like everybody had their role and that's why we won
quotes.quote: I really feel like everybody had their role and that's why we won. Is guys were ready. I mean, look at Mo Williams, doesn't get enough credit for coming in. Dante Jones came in, gave us big minutes. Deli gave big minutes in 15 and 16, like small stints and just the personalities just really fit. So I'm not saying nobody, nobody. I think the team was perfect.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye argues that tanking is an inevitable part of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: There's always going to be tanking. It has to exist
quotes.quote: There's always going to be tanking. It has to exist. It's hard as a fan to think that basketball isn't just basketball. The NBA is a business and so, you know, if you want to make money on your team for the most part, you got to, you can't have a high payroll. It's just not going to work. And think about, okay, Indiana, think about Boston or San Antonio. They've won through the draft by tanking.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye admits to leaving games early in his career
quotes.excerpt: Early on in the in the career when my diet wasn't that good
quotes.quote: Early on in the in the career when my diet wasn't that good, then I was like, man, I can only eat one thing before the game and it got to be the same thing all the time. Steak, potatoes, veggies. It got to be as simple as possible because you cannot be going boo-boo in your pants. That is the worst nightmare.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye identifies 2010-2011 as his peak season
quotes.excerpt: I went from shooting 20 shots, 20 threes to making 172. That's a that's a big leap
quotes.quote: I went from shooting 20 shots, 20 threes to making 172. That's a that's a big leap for anybody. And then all of a sudden the league started catching on and I had like Andre Iguodala guarding me. And I played with him in college, he was our point guard. So I was like, yeah, this is, and I was a center, true center. So yeah, 2010-11.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye explains his role as a big man shooter
quotes.excerpt: If we shot 25 threes, we were like, oh my God, they're not touching the paint
quotes.quote: If we shot 25 threes, we were like, oh my God, they're not touching the paint. But Steve Nash, Alvin Gentry, Grant Hill, Jason Richardson, and Amare sat down and it was like, hey, this is how we play. We're a space and when you have the best screen and roller or best screen and roll in the game, that's going to be your style. We're not really a post-up team like that, unless it's Amare in an advantage or Robin Lopez in an advantage. So for them to be successful, Channing, you have to stand here or you have to stand here. You're going to get criticized, but we're going to win games.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye discusses the Portland Trail Blazers' arena situation
quotes.excerpt: Moda Center is one of the oldest, least renovated or up-to-date arenas in the NBA
quotes.quote: In Portland, Moda Center is one of the oldest, least renovated or up-to-date arenas in the NBA. It's just a fact. Is it a good arena? For sure. Is it compared to where the Suns play, Sacramento play, not even going to talk about LA games, we're not going to talk about Utah's redone, I said Phoenix, San Antonio, like you need to move Moda Center so that there's a mini city around it.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye describes what makes a bad teammate
quotes.excerpt: You're coming in, you're not happy about your job, you're complaining, you're dry snitching on people
quotes.quote: You're coming in, you're not happy about your job, you're complaining, you're dry snitching on people, you're like trying to be a locker room lawyer. I've had a couple teammates like that where I was just like, dude, enjoy this process. And you know what, maybe sometimes I've been a grouch on bad teams and kind of like a don't give a shit type of guy, but I came to work with a good attitude. There were guys that just every day was something because it's woe is me and I hate woe is me teammates.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye lists the players he wishes he played with longer
quotes.excerpt: Obviously LeBron, Steve Nash, Kobe Bryant
quotes.quote: Obviously LeBron, Steve Nash, Kobe Bryant. You got a chance to win. So LeBron and Kobe, we're going for chips. But playing for Steve, hey, you going to get them numbers up. You go get the numbers up.
